title: Onramp Velocity Activation Canvas for Cross-Functional Hires
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, operational canvas to accelerate cross-functional hires (PMs, TPMs, Solutions Eng, Data Ops) into high-impact contributors faster than our standard playbook. Focus is on velocity — what a hire needs to do, who helps them, and the minimal measurable signals at each checkpoint.

Scope / assumptions:
- Applies to mid-level (IC4/EM1) cross-functional hires joining product or platform-adjacent pods.
- Not a replacement for compliance/security onboarding; assumes those flows are already executed in parallel.
- Intentionally opinionated: fewer meetings early, stronger mentor ownership, and measurable micro-projects in week1-4.

Hiring plan snapshot (timeline):
- Week -4 to -2 (offer acceptance -> before start): hardware & access checklist triggered; hiring manager fills role activation brief; buddy assigned.
- Week -1: onboarding kickoff packet (team org, tech stack primers, 1 pager: current top 3 priorities).
- Day 0: induction (HR + IT + manager intro).
- Weeks 1-4: Activation sprint (shipping a micro-deliverable).
- Weeks 5-12: Breadth and ownership handoff; expand scope to a small production feature or runbook.
- 3-month check: performance calibration + retention signal review.

Interview funnel & rubric (practical + velocity focus):
- Stage 1: Screen (30 min) — cultural fit + role clarity (score 1-4)
  - Criteria: clear examples of cross-team delivery, bias for action.
- Stage 2: Technical / functional deep dive (60 min) — tradeoffs & ops thinking (score 1-6)
  - Criteria: problem decomposition, incident postmortem experience, measurable outcomes.
- Stage 3: Take-home micro-case (asynchronous, 72h window)
  - Deliverable graded on practicality, measurable success metrics, and operationalization plan.
- Stage 4: Onsite / loop (3x 45m) — collaboration, system design for short time horizons, stakeholder communication (composite score 1-12)
  - Whiteboard exercise emphasizes shipping and rollback plans, not theoretical edge cases.

Scoring guidance (quick):
- Hire if total normalized score >= 75% AND take-home demonstrates a tangible plan that could be executed in 2–4 weeks.
- Use concrete evidence: past metrics, runbook excerpts, or PR links.

Activation canvas (what the new hire must achieve to be considered "activated"):
- Week 1 goal: Read + annotate 3 core docs; complete 2 access checklists; ship first small change with reviewer sign-off.
- Week 2 goal: Own a 1-week/biweekly micro-project plan; pair with mentor for 4 hours; reduce time-to-first-merge by documenting repeatable steps.
- Week 4 goal: Deliver the micro-project to staging or equivalent; produce one-pager: impact, metrics, roll-forward plan.
- Week 8 goal: Own a recurring operational task (incident runbook, dashboard upkeep, routing policy) with minimal guidance.

Mentor rotation and obligations (decentralized model):
- Primary mentor (first 4 weeks): day-to-day technical/ops unblocker, review first deliverable, inspects onboarding notes weekly.
- Secondary cross-functional mentor (weeks 3–12): broader engagement — product/infra decisions, system tradeoffs.
- Mentor duties (checklist): 30m daily standup first week, 1x weekly deep sync, review notes in shared doc, escalate blockers to manager.

Onboarding checklist (minimal viable set):
- Admin: payroll, benefits enrollment, policy acknowledgements.
- Access: email, VPN, repo read, staging write, monitoring dashboards.
- Tools: local dev environment, infra credentials, runbook access, Slack channels.
- Context: 3 historical PRs to read, 2 prior incident postmortems, top-3 product goals doc.
- Deliverables: first-merge + micro-project plan + week4 one-pager.

Velocity experiments (hypotheses we can run during onboarding):
- Hypothesis A: Assigning a product-context one-pager before day 0 reduces time-to-first-meaningful-ask by 30%.
- Hypothesis B: Replacing 1:1-heavy onboarding with a 2-week activation sprint increases early retention signals (engagement in reviews, PR velocity).
- Metric signals: time-to-first-merge, reviewers-per-PR, doc edits, number of block escalations, engagement score at week 4.

Measurement and success signals (data to collect):
- Quantitative: time to first merge; closed micro-projects; incident involvement count; PR review velocity.
- Qualitative: manager/mentor 4-week activation survey (3 questions), new-hire self-assessment at 30 days.

Operational notes / low-friction automations we should add:
- Auto-generate a starter checklist pre-day0 with links to top-3 docs and first-week project templates.
- Slack onboarding channel stub created automatically including mentor, manager, infra contact.
- Template for week4 one-pager (impact, metrics, risks, follow-ups).

Open questions / tradeoffs to resolve:
- How prescriptive should micro-project topics be vs letting hire choose? (Suggest: provide 3 vetted options aligned to team priorities.)
- Level calibration: should activation canvas differ materially for product vs infra adjacent roles? (Probably yes; include a short branch in the template.)
- Should we gate certain accesses until week2 to force focus? (Security vs velocity tradeoff.)

Next steps (owner + date):
- Pilot in 2 pods (platform-infra + solutions-eng) for hires starting in Jan 2026 — owner: Maya Chen — plan due 2025-11-24.
- Build starter packet generator in onboarding repo — owner: Amit Patel — PR by 2025-12-08.
- Create week4 one-pager template in Confluence and link in starter packet — owner: Sofia Alvarez — done by 2025-11-17.

Notes-to-self / rough fragments (keep for iteration):
- Keep meetings trimmed first two weeks — protect focus windows.
- Consider rewards for mentors who complete structured onboarding reviews (small recognition).
- Log exact access friction points during pilot so SRE/infra can streamline.

Appendix (short checklist template):
- Prior to day0: starter packet sent (Y/N), mentor assigned (Y/N), hardware shipped (Y/N).
- Day0: HR intro, IT verification, manager 30m goal-setting.
- Week1: 3 docs annotated, first-merge, 4 mentor check-ins logged.
- Week4: micro-project delivered, one-pager submitted, activation survey submitted.

This doc is intentionally experimental. Capture pilot learnings in the linked Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-ONBOARD-4321) and iterate the canvas after two pilot hires per pod.
